title: Readjustment Guarantee Rules — Alignment Services & Plans
content:
**Every alignment carries a readjustment guarantee.** Under Alignment Services & Plans an alignment measured out of specification within its guarantee is readjusted.

**Time limit.** The readjustment must be performed no later than the end of the guarantee period counted from the alignment being corrected. The clock starts on the recorded work-order date of the alignment being corrected. Months are counted as calendar months from the anchor date to the same day of the month, falling back to the last day of that month when that day does not exist. The period is the line's guarantee period in months, and a readjustment on its last day is within it.

**Mileage limit.** The vehicle must also have run no more than the line's guarantee mileage since that alignment's odometer. Whichever limit is reached first ends the guarantee.

**Condition and cause.** The vehicle must be measured out of specification, and the cause must not be one of the line's exclusions, as recorded by the technician.

**Labor and parts — no longer in force.** The clause that the readjustment labor is free (a labor charge of 0.00) and that parts needed are charged under the parts warranty only when the part itself failed within the line's parts warranty months and miles is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis for readjustments.

**What a readjustment is.** A readjustment cites the alignment it corrects, never counts as an included alignment and never restarts the plan interval. The guarantee applies on any holding status the alignment was performed under, including a single service whose expiration date is its guarantee end.

### Both limits (hypothetical line with a 6-month, 6000-mile guarantee; alignment on 20 January at 30000 miles)
| Readjustment | Date test | Mileage test | Within the guarantee? |
|---|---|---|---|
| 20 July, 35000 miles | last day — met | 5000 miles — met | Yes |
| 21 July, 35000 miles | day after — not met | met | No |
| 1 April, 36001 miles | met | 6001 miles — not met | No |
| 1 April, 36000 miles | met | 6000 miles — met | Yes |

superseded_clauses: The readjustment labor is free (charge_amount 0.00); parts needed are charged as parts_charge under the parts warranty only when the part itself failed within parts_warranty_months and parts_warranty_miles.
